author: Daniel Niemasz
title: More frost and freeze alerts are active for NCWV - NewsBreak
text:
By Daniel Niemasz ,
8 hours ago BRIDGEPORT, W.Va (WDTV) -Good evening NCWV! We’ve gone through the day seeing intermittent cloud coverage from a weak cold front moving across the area. This system isn’t providing us any rainfall in the area but it will help cool us down for tomorrow. Our highs drop into the mid 60s in the lowlands and the mid 50s in the mountains, and our lows drop into the 30s for the majority of the area tonight and tomorrow night. This has caused the National Weather Service to issue a Frost Advisory for Webster, Upshur, Barbour, Preston, Monongalia County Tucker, Pocahontas, Randolph, and Taylor Counties. This advisory will last until 9:00 AM EST tomorrow. There is also a Freeze Warning which will last until 9:00 AM Friday morning as well, this is for for all of the counties above minus Taylor. We do see our temperatures rapidly rise as we get into Saturday, with highs in the mid to high 70s to low 80s in the lowlands and the low 70s in the mountains. Daniel Niemasz has all of this and more on your First Alert Forecast. Read full article
